blurb: Rooted in a love of community, passion for discovery, and reverence for nature, Two Way Brewing is born of the Hudson Valley. Our inspiration and motivation sprout from this amazing area and everything we love about it. Our passion is to create delicious beer for people to enjoy wherever they gather to have fun, whether that's out of a can on the trail or over a pint on the patio.
